# OSS Labs

> A community of open source engineers building developer tools together.

## Site

- [Home](https://ossl.dev)
- [Projects](https://ossl.dev/projects)
- [Blog](https://ossl.dev/blog)
- [About](https://ossl.dev/about)

## Projects

- [genesis](https://ossl.dev/projects/genesis): Reproducible dev environments defined as code. TypeScript.
- [zinc](https://ossl.dev/projects/zinc): Cross-language shared memory in Rust. Bindings for C, Python, Node, Go.
- [pylon](https://ossl.dev/projects/pylon): API versioning without restructuring your codebase. TypeScript.
- [differens](https://ossl.dev/projects/differens): A diff engine that tells you what actually happened to your code. TypeScript.

## Community

- [GitHub](https://github.com/ossl-dev)
